name: opt_weighted1.k
model:
class OptWeighted1 {
  a:Int
  b:Int

  req a >= 0

  req b >= 0

  req a + b <= 10
  maximize a weight 1
  maximize b weight 3
}

main:OptWeighted1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptWeighted1 (mk-OptWeighted1 (a Int)(b Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OptWeighted1 (sel-OptWeighted1 OptWeighted1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptWeighted1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptWeighted1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptWeighted1 ((this Ref)) OptWeighted1
  (sel-OptWeighted1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptWeighted1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptWeighted1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -----------------------------------
;   Getters for class OptWeighted1:
; -----------------------------------

; --- getters for OptWeighted1.a: ---

(define-fun OptWeighted1!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-OptWeighted1 this))
)

; --- getters for OptWeighted1.b: ---

(define-fun OptWeighted1!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-OptWeighted1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptWeighted1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptWeighted1:
; -------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OptWeighted1 OptWeighted1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptWeighted1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptWeighted1!a this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptWeighted1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptWeighted1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptWeighted1!b this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptWeighted1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun OptWeighted1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (+ (OptWeighted1!a this) (OptWeighted1!b this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (OptWeighted1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(minimize (+ (- (let ((this 1)) (OptWeighted1!a this))) (- (* 3 (let ((this 1)) (OptWeighted1!b this))))))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OptWeighted1 const-1-OptWeighted1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (a (sel-OptWeighted1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptWeighted1 a!1)))
(define-fun const-1-OptWeighted1 () OptWeighted1
  (mk-OptWeighted1 0 10))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (>= (b (sel-OptWeighted1 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (a (sel-OptWeighted1 (select heap 1)))
              (b (sel-OptWeighted1 (select heap 1))))))
  (<= a!1 10)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-OptWeighted1 (mk-OptWeighted1 0 10))))
